slot.brief: Rank three alkyl halides by SN1 reactivity via carbocation stability (include resonance-stabilised allylic); pick correct decreasing order.

stem: Which is the decreasing order of SN1 reactivity?

verdicts.working: 3-Chlorobut-1-ene forms a resonance-stabilized allylic carbocation, so it reacts fastest. 2-Chlorobutane forms a secondary carbocation, which is more stable than the primary carbocation from 1-chlorobutane. Order: 3-chlorobut-1-ene > 2-chlorobutane > 1-chlorobutane.

working:
SN1 reactivity follows carbocation stability: secondary allylic (resonance-stabilised) $>$ secondary alkyl $>$ primary alkyl.
